description: Read the current budget, cost, remaining limits, and stop pressure for one MartinLoop run. Provide exactly one selector: loopJson for an inline record, file for a saved record, loopId for a run-store ID, or latest for the newest run; runsDir only changes the run-store root. Use for a compact budget check. Do not use for full events or artifacts; use martin_get_run or martin_run_dossier instead.

file.description: Path under the Martin runs root to a loop-record.json file, a legacy .jsonl file, or a run-store directory. Mutually exclusive with loopJson, loopId, and latest.

latest.description: When true, loads the most recently updated loop record. Mutually exclusive with loopJson, file, and loopId.

loopId.description: Loop ID resolved as <runsDir>/<loopId>/loop-record.json. Mutually exclusive with loopJson, file, and latest.

runsDir.description: Optional runs-root override resolved under the default Martin runs root.

name: martin_status

activeAttemptId.description: ID of the currently active attempt, when a run is in progress.

appliedControlState.description: Control state reconciled from validated executor application evidence.

pauseState.description: Backwards-compatible applied control state; pending pause requests remain active.

requestedControlState.description: Latest durable operator request; this does not prove executor application.
